text:
ana: Kickoff for LumenSilicon alpha access. Need to confirm NDA, bench plan, and marketplace metadata before we allocate test nodes. Who can take each piece?
bjorn: I can own bench plan + initial harness. Target checks: tokens/s median, p99, memory growth over 12h, and quantized float stability.
li: I'll draft marketplace metadata and embargo dates. Marketing wants a 7-day embargo after final sign-off.
marc: Ops: hold on hardware until NDA countersigned. Please upload NDA to #legal-partnerships and tag @sophia. Also provide run_id for tickets.
nana: (typo-apology) meant to say @ana. NDA file: Lumen_Redwood_Alpha_NDA_2026_v2.pdf uploaded to drive. They requested co-use of anonymized benchmarks.
legal-bot: @ana @marc Please ensure the NDA includes: anonymized aggregated metrics allowed, raw traces only via signed debug token, deletion after 90 days. Recommend explicit approval step for co-marketing.
bjorn: Bench harness snippet: ```
./lumen_bench --model rwd-7b-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 6 --iters 800 \\n  --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.internal/v1/ingest \\n  --flags --anon-only --partner LumenSilicon
```
bjorn: Sample log: `2026-04-02T22:01:05Z INFO throughput=1123.2 p50=11.2ms p95=26.1ms p99=51.9ms vram_pct=69%`
li: Marketplace stub: regions [us-west1, us-east1], preview: limited, pricing: TBD, sla: preview best-effort. I'll add compliance notes.
marc: Ops checklist: NDA countersigned, ticket with run_id, badge access, harness flag --anon-only set. I can provision 1 x Lumen-LS8 node Tue 10:00-14:00 if NDA done.
nana: (again) sorry, file name corrected on drive. Also they want a short joint announcement review window of 48 hours.
legal-bot: Noted. Proposed clause: "Redwood will share aggregated benchmark metrics; raw traces may be shared to Lumen under signed debug token limited to 7 days, with automatic deletion after 90 days unless mutually agreed."
bjorn: I'll add a --debug-token that only uploads to a partner-signed URL and expires. Default runs will use --anon-only.
li: I'll own announcement checklist and co-marketing approvals. Please tag me when perf report is ready.
marc: Creating ops ticket LUMEN-ALPHA-1 (NDA attach), LUMEN-ALPHA-2 (bench dry-run Tue), LUMEN-ALPHA-3 (provision LS8 node).
nana: Sophia in legal says countersign expected EOD today.
nana: If all good, next sync Thurs 09:30 to confirm run and embargo timing.
li: :thumbsup:
